_: Journal PROGRESSION on a Story-Manager-triggered quest. Demonstrates two things with no hand-written quest script: (1) startUpStage — the engine auto-SetStages stage 10 the instant the SM event starts the quest, so its opening objective displays in the journal; (2) completion via an alias OnActivate script (MFSE_AdvanceStage) that runs SetStage(20), completing the objective and closing the quest. Chain: addspell + cast Forge Errand (MFSE_ErrandSpell) -> MFSE_SpellTrigger -> Fire(MFSE_ErrandKW, caster) -> SM starts MFSE_Errand at startUpStage 10 -> objective 'Open the supply cache' shows; the Cache alias createObjects a vanilla chest at the caster. OPEN that chest -> MFSE_AdvanceStage OnActivate -> SetStage(20) -> objective completes + quest closes (stage 20 completeQuest). In-game: `player.addspell <MFSE_ErrandSpell formid>`, cast it (objective appears + a chest spawns at your feet), open the chest, watch the objective tick complete and the quest finish.

magicEffects.name: Forge Errand
magicEffects._: Self token effect so OnEffectStart runs on the caster; payload is the attached MFSE_SpellTrigger.

quests.name: Forge Errand
quests._: Started by the SM ScriptEvent root when MFSE_ErrandKW fires (the spell). startUpStage 10 fires automatically on start -> objective 0 displays. Opening the createObject'd Cache runs MFSE_AdvanceStage -> SetStage(20) -> objective 0 completes + quest closes (stage 20 completeQuest).

stages.logEntry: A forge errand has begun. Open the supply cache.
The supply cache is open. The errand is done.

aliases.name: Cache
aliases._: Spawns a vanilla small chest at the Caster, and carries the advance-stage alias script. Opening it (OnActivate) advances the owning quest to stage 20.
